desc: Ideation: reduction to even-parity labelling, loss = min-cost flow on 4-node graph {L0,L1,L2,W}, exactly 4 admissible divergence vectors, candidate pruning to top-2 per (group, op type)

Implement full solution: fast IO + baseline (`m_i`, argmax label, top-2K, `M`, parity check) + per-(group,type) top-2 candidate lists + closed-form enumeration of the 5 simple path shapes (with `C1`/`C2` distinct-cake handling) → print `M − min loss`

Analytical audit / hand-execution of both official samples and adversarial edge cases (drop+add through W, two-hop relabel, candidate collision requiring two distinct cakes, N=2K, ties at the 2K boundary, empty groups/INF sentinel)

Correctness re-derivation: max-labelling reduction, `M` upper bound, non-negativity of all simple cycles/paths (`m_selected ≥ m_unselected ≥ v_{unselected,·}`), minimal T-join argument for T={p,q} ⇒ only 4 divergence vectors, ≤2 paths ⇒ top-2 lists suffice
Performance check: O(N log N) per test dominated by one sort; ≤60 constant-size evaluations per test; no graph/SPFA construction; safe for T=1000 with ΣN ≤ 1e5
